description: Calibration against the winner's curse, with no recipe change and nothing kept. Run the E061 tip code unchanged on fresh held-out seeds 13-22 (10 trials) outside the official command, using the existing trial-seed plumbing. Log per-seed accuracy and time. Seeds 13-22 then stay out of all selection, and are used only for the final pre-submission check of whichever tip exists at the end. Dev seeds 3-12 have now driven about 6 keep decisions (E053, E054, E055, E056, E058, E061), so the dev mean of the current tip is likely biased upward.
